passages.text: A Psalms of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was fleeing from his son Absalom.
Absalom was David’s son.
David was in danger.
David prayed to God during this time.

passages.text: O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David fled from his son Absalom.
David spoke to the LORD.
David said, “O LORD, my enemies have become many.”
Many people rise up against me.
passages.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בְּ֝בָרְח֗וֹ מִפְּנֵ֤י׀ אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽוֹ׃ יְ֭הוָה מָֽה־ רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
passages.sermon:
David fled from his son Absalom.
Many people speak about David.
They say, “God will not save him.”
But You, LORD, protect me like a shield.
You give me honor.
You lift up my head.
passages.original: רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֪ים לְנַ֫פְשִׁ֥י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָה לּ֬וֹ בֵֽאלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה׃ וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה מָגֵ֣ן בַּעֲדִ֑י כְּ֝בוֹדִ֗י וּמֵרִ֥ים רֹאשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
passages.sermon:
David was in danger from his son Absalom.
David cried out loudly to the LORD.
The LORD answered David.
The LORD answered from His holy mountain.
David lay down and slept.
David woke up again.
The LORD kept David safe.
The LORD supported David.
passages.original: ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּֽעֲנֵ֨נִי מֵהַ֖ר קָדְשׁ֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃ אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָֽאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David faces many enemies.
These enemies surround him on every side.
There are thousands of them.
David does not fear them.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ אִ֭ירָא מֵרִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David calls the LORD by name.
David asks the LORD to arise.
David asks God to save him.
David calls God "my God."
David says God strikes all his enemies on the jaw.
David says God breaks the teeth of the wicked.
passages.original: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהַ֗י כִּֽי־ הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹיְבַ֣י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃

passages.text: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah
passages.sermon:
The LORD gives salvation.
The LORD owns salvation.
The LORD blesses His people.
Let Your blessing be on Your people.
Selah.
passages.original: לַיהוָ֥ה הַיְשׁוּעָ֑ה עַֽל־ עַמְּךָ֖ בִרְכָתֶ֣ךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
